description: Bornes de charge IRVE du réseau métropolitain "larecharge" avec leur localisation is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole d'Aix-Marseille-Provence. Liste des bornes de recharge avec leur localisation appartenant au réseau métropolitain "larecharge", supervision par evzen / freshmile. Ces données sont mises à jour toutes les 5 minutes. Coverage: Métropole d'Aix-Marseille-Provence. The publisher named on the listing is Métropole d'Aix-Marseille-Provence. Its keywords include irve, charge, bornes, electromobilite, transports. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ZIP, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-07-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
